summary: Preterit Intransitive qaṭəl forms report completed flight, with ʕariqo feminine and ʕariqi plural; the narrative use and repetition do not create a Part act. box.

MAC NE ezo koviye/9 explicitly contrasts community choices koʕurqo and máhəzmo. This is primary speaker evidence for a lexical preference, but the input alone does not establish which broader dialect areas use each.

I marks the fleeing participant as subject. III promotes a cause/removal agent and indexes an affected object; apples, recovered eyes, an abducted woman and a person helped away are not interchangeable event roles.

LuF apple theft occurs in dream imagery and in its explanation. Symbolic breasts do not establish a new sexual meaning of the verb. Existing parallel-reference bundles are not counted as multiple quotations.
Confirm III maʕraqalli in Lahdo Traitor 1/45 as caused escape rather than covert removal with another nuance; the exact number of the police agents is unclear in the free translation.
What gender/number form is ʕraq in MAC NE Mem and Zin/41, addressed to a wife? Keep the attested shape rather than supplying an unattested feminine Imperativ.

Animals, transformed humans and ordinary humans all flee with the same intransitive construction; no separate species senses.
